run_pipeline_cogvideox_image2video: run the CogVideoXImageToVideoPipeline to generate a video from a single input image and text prompt
encode_prompt_t5: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings with optional negative prompts and classifier-free guidance
prepare_latents_image2video: prepare video latents by encoding an input image and padding with noise for image-to-video generation
decode_latents_to_video: decode denoised video latents back to pixel-space frames using the VAE decoder
prepare_rotary_positional_embeddings: prepare 3D rotary positional embeddings for spatial and temporal dimensions in the transformer denoising loop
